network.offlineHint: Atap stops using the internet straight away. The notch keeps showing what it saved last time. Checking for updates is not affected.
network.wifiNameHint: Lets Atap know which Wi-Fi you are on, so it can show different things at home and at work. Rules for each network come in a later update. The name stays on this PC. Windows may ask to use your location, because a Wi-Fi name can show where you are.
